title: Escutcheon
summary: ESCUTCH'EON, noun [Latin scutum, a shield.] The shield on which a coat of arms is represented; the shield of a family; the picture of ensigns armorial.

inlines.v: ESCUTCH'EON, noun [Latin scutum, a shield.] The shield on which a coat of arms is represented; the shield of a family; the picture of ensigns armorial.
